events.text: Time of death recorded in the official police report.
Julian Marsh phones Dr. Vane (47 seconds), 32 minutes after his reported time of death.
Officer with badge 4417 logs arrival at the premises.
112 emergency call registered on the dispatch switchboard, 15 minutes after badge 4417 arrived.
Patient file P-0912 edited and locked by Dr. Vane, three days after Julian Marsh was killed.
Recording Seven made: Dr. Vane with Mira Vale (P-0101).
Noah Mercer dropped off one block from the Vane residence by private hire cab (E7).
A global maintenance window starts under authority credentials.
Garage keypad override entered by A. Cross, 13 minutes after Adrian badged out of the front entrance. The panel alarm stays suppressed.
Dr. Elias Vane's last confirmed activity: workstation input at 21:52:07 IST, study motion at 21:52:04.
Desk clock stopped here. It was staged to point investigators at the wrong time.
Time claimed for Adrian Cross's alibi photo. It was actually taken at Diu, and is not from that night.
True medical examiner window of death.
Lena Vane exits the dinner parking garage (E3).
Study locked remotely via TABLET_API. It was never locked from the inside.
Lena Vane's sedan seen on a neighbour's doorbell camera outside Ridge Road (E3).
lena.v, on device LENA_IPAD, deletes record R-0003 (Recording Three).
